statement: 1. For each disk matching α, let ai ∈ {0, 1} record whether its site i is occupied. Its coordinate satisfies ΦN,α = ( ∏ i x −ai/2 i ) pN (x)ψN,α is polynomial, of degree ≤ N − 1 − ai in xi. (5.4) This prescription is for N ≥ 1; we suppress the coordinate subscript when the matching is fixed. 24 2. Exchange of adjacent labels is implemented by Ř as above. At adjacent pairs with earlier rapidity equal to later rapidity plus 3λ, 2λ, respectively, ψN reduces to KψN−2, JψN−1 inserted at that pair; the new single label for J has midpoint rapidity. Here these are identities for generic parameters subject to the indicated condition, with disk rotation allowed (we call these the descending pairs). The row fixes ψN . With one variable tending to zero or infinity and the rest generic, the normalized vector tends to the one with that site vacant and deleted.
